title: Rioproperty statement
description: A plain paper section with a big wide capital heading in deep indigo, then a split row: a violet capital sub-head or a small arrow link at the left, and a narrow column of grey copy in the last third of the page. The heading's words ripple up out of masks with the scroll, the copy fades up 30px, the link fades in.
notes: used twice on the landing page: as the intro (link at the left) and as the off-market note (sub-head at the left, link under the copy)
wide makes the heading run over two thirds of the page
